title: ProgramAssetsStoragePath
description: Private programme files at programs/{programId}/{assetKind}/{assetId}: guest IDs (guestIds), hamper photos (hampers), function photos (photos) and the guest page cover (branding). Clients upload through one short-lived backend-signed POST policy (createProgramAssetUpload) whose metadata binds the object to its programme, kind and subject; reads are short-lived signed URLs minted by the reads allowed to show them. The archive retention sweep deletes the whole programs/{programId}/ prefix.
x-storage-read: server-signed access only; direct client reads denied
x-storage-write: server-signed upload only; direct client writes denied
